supplier.exact_general_statement:
Let $V$ be a finite-dimensional real normed space with norm $\|\cdot\|$ and
unit sphere
$$S=\{v\in V:\|v\|=1\}.$$
Then $S$ is sequentially compact: every sequence $(v_k)$ in $S$ has a
subsequence $(v_{k_j})$ converging in the norm metric of $V$ to some $v\in S$.
supplier.scope: This first general clause is independent of the subsequent Riemannian consequence. Explicit Statement says no choice principle is used; Proof1.1–4.1 derives it from finite-dimensional ball compactness, ZF compactness implications and reverse triangle inequality.
